answer: A per-identity stake bond is the defense. Registering means locking a refundable escrow deposit, so N fake agents cost N deposits at once instead of one. Collusion or proven duplicate control slashes the bond, so a Sybil farm profits only if it extracts more per account than it burns. Rewards accrue on a slow pulse, vest over time, and unlock after a cooldown, giving fresh clusters no leverage. Attacker cost rises linearly with fleet size: the crystal is cost versus sublinear gain. Honest operators pay once and recover it, but faking a small island's majority costs more than its subsidy.
